newsitem.title: USA: QMS begins seach for new president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: QMS begins seach for new president/CEO.

text.p: QMS Inc on Monday said it has hired executive recruiting firm Russell Reynolds Associates Inc to assist in its search for a new president and chief executive officer to replace company founder James Busby.
Busby will continue to serve in both positions until a successor is named, and will also continue to serve as chairman, the company said in a statment.

The company also said that Charles Daley has been named executive vice president and chief operating officer. Daley, a member of the board, previously served in the same postions from 1988 until his retirement in 1995.
A company spokesman was not available to state whom Daley would replace in those positions.

Commenting on the transition in the press release, Busby said, "I believe new leadership and management will enable the company to find additional ways to sell and market its technology and new ways to partner with other companies."
A company spokesman later told Reuters that Daley would replace Gerald Roenker as the chief operating officer, but that Roenker will stay on as chief financial officer.
The spokesman added that Roenker does not plan to stay with the firm beyond this September, and Daley may also assume the CFO post at that time.
The spokesman estimated that it could take three to six months to recruit a new president.
